synopsis: The public panel is nearly done, but one block of caption is a bare rectangle where a withdrawn passage used to sit, and the blank reads like a mistake. In the library, Stasi, Ruparna, and Xingyu build the final form under the constraint that nothing withdrawn may come back: Stasi marks the withheld place with a plain tab that shows nothing, Ruparna keeps it out of frame, and Xingyu's ear catches where a vivid clause smuggles the certainty back. The line ends vivid and honest, and it is the constraint that gets it there, with nothing withdrawn brought back to do the work.

scenes.goal: Reach the moment the class stops trying to fill the withdrawn block and reframes the job as holding its place without showing it, and Stasi marks that place with a plain tab.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Faced with a blank that reads like a mistake, will the class fill the gap or design a mark that keeps it open on purpose?
scenes.learnerNeed: A stance on a plan that preserves a withheld place instead of restoring its content.

nodes.description: Rain runs down the tall library windows. The near-final public panel lies flat across the long table, its blocks of caption set in reading order. One block is a bare rectangle of card where a withdrawn passage used to sit. Jenny has already re-blocked the panel from the back bench so the empty block falls where the layout can carry it, then gone back to her own work. Tom's old paper cat sits in an open box at the table's edge.

nodes.intent: Name the plain problem: the blank reads like a dropped stitch and they can't restore what was removed, so the real task is to build an absence that doesn't look like a gap.
nodes.attentionTarget: the bare block, and the way an eye falls into it rather than past it

n2.japanese: ここ、空白のままだと、抜けたみたいに見えるんだよね。目がそこに落ちる。でも、消したものを戻すわけにはいかないし……かといって、ただ白く空けておくと、忘れたのかって思われる。
n2.reading: ここ、くうはくのままだと、ぬけたみたいにみえるんだよね。めがそこにおちる。でも、けしたものをもどすわけにはいかないし……かといって、ただしろくあけておくと、わすれたのかっておもわれる。
n2.english: Here — if we leave it blank, it looks like something dropped out. The eye falls into it. But we can't put back what we removed… and yet if we just leave it white and open, people will think we forgot.

n1.japanese: ここ、白いまま残すと、どうしても“抜け落ちた”ように見えるんだよね。目が吸い込まれる。かといって、外したものを戻すわけにはいかない——戻さずに、それでも欠けて見せない。そこをどう作るか、なんだと思う。
n1.reading: ここ、しろいままのこすと、どうしても“ぬけおちた”ようにみえるんだよね。めがすいこまれる。かといって、はずしたものをもどすわけにはいかない——もどさずに、それでもかけてみせない。そこをどうつくるか、なんだとおもう。
n1.english: Here — leave it white and it always reads as if something fell out. Your eye gets pulled in. But we can't put back what we took out. Restore nothing, and still don't let it look like a gap. Making that — that's the whole problem, I think.

nodes.intent: Reframe it from restoration to framing: the question is what to keep out of frame. Use the subtitle logic that a part you chose not to show stays truer unshown. Point at the room; don't open the door.
nodes.attentionTarget: the edge of the block as a frame line, and everything the frame is allowed to leave out

n2.japanese: 戻すものの話じゃないと思う。フレームの外に、何を置いたままにするか——そっちの話だよ。字幕と同じで、映さないって決めた部分は、映さないままのほうが正確なの。部屋を指せばいい。ドアは開けなくていい。
n2.reading: もどすもののはなしじゃないとおもう。フレームのそとに、なにをおいたままにするか——そっちのはなしだよ。じまくとおなじで、うつさないってきめたぶぶんは、うつさないままのほうがせいかくなの。へやをさせばいい。ドアはあけなくていい。
n2.english: I don't think this is about what to put back. It's about what to leave outside the frame — that's the question. Same as a subtitle: the part you decided not to show stays truer left unshown. Point at the room. You don't have to open the door.

n1.japanese: たぶん、“何を戻すか”じゃないんだよね。フレームの外に、何を残しておくか。字幕でもそうだけど、あえて映さないと決めたところは、映さないほうがむしろ正確で。部屋のほうを指すだけでいい——ドアまで開けなくても、ちゃんと伝わる。
n1.reading: たぶん、“なにをもどすか”じゃないんだよね。フレームのそとに、なにをのこしておくか。じまくでもそうだけど、あえてうつさないときめたところは、うつさないほうがむしろせいかくで。へやのほうをさすだけでいい——ドアまであけなくても、ちゃんとつたわる。
n1.english: It's probably not 'what to put back.' It's what to keep outside the frame. It's like a subtitle — the place you chose not to show is more accurate left unshown. Just point toward the room. You don't have to open the door for it to land.

nodes.question: Stasi wants to mark the withheld block so its place is kept without its content shown. How do you back it?

options.action: Commit — put a plain, deliberately dull marker there whose only message is that something is kept out, nothing like the old mascot.

japaneseByBand.n2: じゃあ、目印を置こう。前のあの猫とは別の、うんと地味なやつ。“ここに、出せないものがある”ってことだけ伝わる印にしよう。
japaneseByBand.n1: じゃあ、印を一つ置こう。前のあの猫みたいに可愛いのじゃなくて、うんと地味な——“ここには、出さないと決めたものがある”それだけを伝える印。中身は言わない。場所だけ残す。

options.action: Ask to read the vivid version aloud first, to check the withdrawn detail hasn't quietly crept back before you mark anything.

japaneseByBand.n2: 印の前に、一回声に出して読んでみない?この“いい感じ”の言い方、消したはずのところがこっそり戻ってきてないか、確かめてから決めよう。
japaneseByBand.n1: 印を置く前に、一度声に出して読んでみようよ。この“据わりのいい”言い回し、外したはずのものがこっそり滑り込んでないか——確かめてからにしない?

nodes.resume: The learner has backed a plan to hold the withheld place rather than fill it. Stasi answers by designing the mark.

nodes.intent: Pay off the paper-cat: set a plain new marker in the withheld block's place and name the reversal. The old cat pointed at the clue; this one shows nothing and only keeps a place that must not be filled.
nodes.attentionTarget: the plain tab going down beside the bare block, and the boxed paper cat it looks nothing like

n2.japanese: 昔は、あの紙の猫で“どこが大事か”を教えてたよね。今日は逆。これは、何も教えない印。ただ“ここは空けてある、わざとだ”っていう場所だけを守る。中身の代わりじゃなくて、中身を出さないための印なんだ。
n2.reading: むかしは、あのかみのねこで“どこがだいじか”をおしえてたよね。きょうはぎゃく。これは、なにもおしえないしるし。ただ“ここはあけてある、わざとだ”っていうばしょだけをまもる。なかみのかわりじゃなくて、なかみをださないためのしるしなんだ。
n2.english: Back then, that paper cat told you where the important thing was. Today it's the opposite. This is a marker that tells you nothing. It only holds the place — 'this is left open, on purpose.' Not a stand-in for the content. A marker for keeping the content out.

n1.japanese: 前は、あの紙の猫が“ここを見て”って教える役だったでしょ。今日のこれは、真逆なんだよね。何も見せないための印。地味でいい——むしろ地味じゃなきゃ困る。“ここは、わざと空けてある”それだけを守って、中身の代わりには絶対にならない。埋めちゃいけない場所を、埋めずに残しておくための印。
n1.reading: まえは、あのかみのねこが“ここをみて”っておしえるやくだったでしょ。きょうのこれは、まぎゃくなんだよね。なにもみせないためのしるし。じみでいい——むしろじみじゃなきゃこまる。“ここは、わざとあけてある”それだけをまもって、なかみのかわりにはぜったいにならない。うめちゃいけないばしょを、うめずにのこしておくためのしるし。
n1.english: Before, that paper cat's job was to say 'look here.' This one is the exact reverse. A marker for showing nothing. Plain is fine — plain is the point. It holds one thing: 'this is left open, deliberately.' It never stands in for what's missing. A marker for keeping a place you mustn't fill, unfilled.

nodes.description: Stasi lowers the matte grey bar by two millimetres and walks back to Jenny's bench. From there the eye lands on the caption's first verb, not the white block. Jenny gives one small nod and returns to her work; the measurement is written on the production copy.

scenes.goal: Turn the constraint into the final revised caption line: vivid, restoring nothing withdrawn, keeping the marker's place. The learner identifies the bounded revision from three visible options.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Can a line be cut down under a hard constraint and come out sharper instead of plainer?
scenes.learnerNeed: A recognition check where the learner identifies the vivid bounded line that restores no withdrawn detail.

nodes.description: On the board, the draft is pinned up large: 「この道は、戻らなかった人の願いを受け継ぎ、今夜も灯る。」 The middle clause leans on the very detail the class agreed to withhold. Beneath it, the bounded candidate is written once: 「この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。」 The grey marker stays in its block below both lines.

nodes.intent: Use her ear as the accuracy tool: read the line aloud like a song, notice the clause that feels too good, and propose dropping it to test whether the line stands on its own or was leaning on the withdrawn certainty.
nodes.attentionTarget: the middle clause, and how good it feels in the mouth versus whether the sentence needs it

n2.japanese: まず今の文ね。『この道は、戻らなかった人の願いを受け継ぎ、今夜も灯る。』……次は真ん中を抜くよ。『この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。』ほら、最初のほうは、声が真ん中に引っぱられるでしょう。そこは、出さないって決めた話だよね。
n2.reading: まずいまのぶんね。『このみちは、もどらなかったひとのねがいをうけつぎ、こんやもともる。』……つぎはまんなかをぬくよ。『このみちは、こんやもしずかにともる。』ほら、さいしょのほうは、こえがまんなかにひっぱられるでしょう。そこは、ださないってきめたはなしだよね。
n2.english: First, the line as it stands: 'This path inherits the hopes of those who did not return, and shines again tonight.' …Now without the middle: 'This path shines quietly again tonight.' Hear how the first one pulls the voice into its middle? That is the story we agreed not to publish.

n1.japanese: まず草稿ね。『この道は、戻らなかった人の願いを受け継ぎ、今夜も灯る。』……次は真ん中を抜いて、『この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。』草稿のほう、真ん中で声がそこへ引っ張られるでしょ。そこが、出さないって決めた話なんだよね。
n1.reading: まずそうこうね。『このみちは、もどらなかったひとのねがいをうけつぎ、こんやもともる。』……つぎはまんなかをぬいて、『このみちは、こんやもしずかにともる。』そうこうのほう、まんなかでこえがそこへひっぱられるでしょ。そこが、ださないってきめたはなしなんだよね。
n1.english: First, the draft: 'This path inherits the hopes of those who did not return, and shines again tonight.' …Then without the middle: 'This path shines quietly again tonight.' In the draft, the voice gets pulled toward that middle, doesn't it? That is the story we agreed not to publish.

nodes.intent: Lock the three plain editing conditions (keep the vividness, put nothing withdrawn back, keep the marker's place), then hand the learner a choice among visible revisions with an easy way to decline.
nodes.attentionTarget: the three things that must not move, and the one line the learner is being handed

n2.japanese: 条件は三つ。動詞の色は残す。外した事実は戻さない。灰色の線は動かさない。……この一文、直してみる? 気が乗らなければ、私がやる。
n2.reading: じょうけんはみっつ。どうしのいろはのこす。はずしたじじつはもどさない。はいいろのせんはうごかさない。……このいちぶん、なおしてみる? きがのらなければ、わたしがやる。
n2.english: Three conditions. Keep the colour in the verb. Don't restore the fact we removed. Don't move the grey bar. …Want to revise this sentence? If you're not feeling it, I'll do it.

n1.japanese: 条件は三つだけ。動詞の鮮やかさは残す。外した事実は戻さない。灰色の線は動かさない。……この一文、直してみる? 気が乗らなければ、私が引き取る。
n1.reading: じょうけんはみっつだけ。どうしのあざやかさはのこす。はずしたじじつはもどさない。はいいろのせんはうごかさない。……このいちぶん、なおしてみる? きがのらなければ、わたしがひきとる。
n1.english: Only three conditions. Keep the vividness in the verb. Don't restore the fact we removed. Don't move the grey bar. …Want to revise this sentence? If you're not feeling it, I'll take it.

nodes.resume: The learner can see both lines: the draft 「この道は、戻らなかった人の願いを受け継ぎ、今夜も灯る。」 and the bounded candidate 「この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。」 The task is to identify the line that stays vivid without restoring the withdrawn claim.

nodes.resumeContext: The visible draft is 「この道は、戻らなかった人の願いを受け継ぎ、今夜も灯る。」 Choose the revision that removes the unsupported claim, preserves the vivid final verb, and restores no withdrawn detail.

nodes.description: Compare the middle clauses again. The candidate 「この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。」 keeps the visible image without putting the withdrawn claim back on the wall.

nodes.resume: The selected line stays inside the constraint. Stasi reads it back and gives her own reason for preferring it.

nodes.intent: Land the arc: the constrained line came out sharper, not smaller. It reached this shape because they could not restore or fill, and it kept every bit of the vividness while letting no lie in.
nodes.attentionTarget: the cut line reading stronger than the draft, and the marker still holding its place below

n2.japanese: ……二メートル。うん、最初に『灯る』が目に入る。灰色の線は見えるけど、もう穴には見えない。
n2.reading: ……にメートル。うん、さいしょに『ともる』がめにはいる。はいいろのせんはみえるけど、もうあなにはみえない。
n2.english: …Two metres. Yes, 'shines' is the first thing my eye catches. I can see the grey line, but it no longer looks like a hole.

n1.japanese: ……二メートル。うん、最初に『灯る』が目に入る。灰色の線は見えてる。でも、もう穴には見えない。
n1.reading: ……にメートル。うん、さいしょに『ともる』がめにはいる。はいいろのせんはみえてる。でも、もうあなにはみえない。
n1.english: …Two metres. Yes, 'shines' is the first thing my eye catches. The grey line is still visible, but it no longer looks like a hole.

nodes.intent: Close her framing arc: what they chose not to show stays unshown to the end, and the piece is finished and honest. Filling it without showing it is the hardest thing to pull off, and it worked.
nodes.attentionTarget: the whole panel reading as complete despite the kept-out block

n2.japanese: 私は横から見るね。……切った境界は残ってる。でも、中身は出てない。これなら、クロップが嘘をつかない。
n2.reading: わたしはよこからみるね。……きったきょうかいはのこってる。でも、なかみはでてない。これなら、クロップがうそをつかない。
n2.english: I'll check it from the side. …The cut edge remains, but the content is not showing. This way, the crop does not lie.

n1.japanese: 私は横から見るね。……切った境界は残ってる。でも、中身は出てない。これなら、クロップが嘘をつかない。
n1.reading: わたしはよこからみるね。……きったきょうかいはのこってる。でも、なかみはでてない。これなら、クロップがうそをつかない。
n1.english: I'll check it from the side. …The cut edge remains, but the content is not showing. This way, the crop does not lie.

nodes.intent: Sign off by singing the finished line through once: nothing drops, it stands all the way, and it can go out.
nodes.attentionTarget: the finished line read end to end, checking nothing collapses

n2.japanese: じゃ、声で一回。『この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。』……うん。途中で別の話にそれない。『灯る』までまっすぐ届く。
n2.reading: じゃ、こえでいっかい。『このみちは、こんやもしずかにともる。』……うん。とちゅうでべつのはなしにそれない。『ともる』までまっすぐとどく。
n2.english: One read aloud, then: 'This path shines quietly again tonight.' …Yes. It does not veer into another story. It reaches 'shines' in a straight line.

n1.japanese: じゃ、声で一回。『この道は、今夜も静かに灯る。』……うん。途中で別の話にそれない。『灯る』までまっすぐ届く。
n1.reading: じゃ、こえでいっかい。『このみちは、こんやもしずかにともる。』……うん。とちゅうでべつのはなしにそれない。『ともる』までまっすぐとどく。
n1.english: One read aloud, then: 'This path shines quietly again tonight.' …Yes. It does not veer into another story. It reaches 'shines' in a straight line.

nodes.description: Stasi steps back two metres, Ruparna checks the crop from the side, and Xingyu reads the finished caption once. Tom closes the paper cat in its box and slides the grey marker across the table. Each person leaves one tested action behind before the panel goes into its rain cover.

callbacks.meaningNow: A new plain marker preserves the place of a withheld passage without exposing its content. The mascot that once pointed at the smallest clue becomes a discipline that holds a space it must not fill.
callbacks.optionalFallback: The class marks the spot where a withdrawn passage sat with a plain placeholder so its place is kept without showing what it held; the public version stays vivid and restores nothing.

outcomes.description: The public panel is finalized vivid without restoring any withdrawn detail: a plain marker preserves the withheld passage's place, the framing keeps it out of frame, and the over-vivid clause is re-cut so the line stands honestly. The final form came from the constraint rather than from anything put back.

Stasi makes the public version vivid without restoring withdrawn content and designs a plain new marker that keeps a withheld passage's place without exposing it; the arc lands as precise without becoming plain, and the class can later ask them to hold an authored absence in staging.

Ruparna's framing decides what stays out of frame; her Chapter 31 limit returns as changed behavior (she can hold the ambiguity and still ship a finished piece), and the class can ask her to frame an honest public version.

Xingyu's ear returns as an accuracy tool rather than a memorability trap; she reads a rewrite aloud to test whether a vivid clause smuggles withdrawn certainty back, proving the Chapter 31 limit landed, and the class can ask her to sing-check a line before it ships.

Jenny returns on the backstage terms she named at Chapter 29 and re-blocks the panel like a finished layout; the class works from her staging without pulling her to the front, proof it heard her stated limit rather than treating it as a gap to fix.

Tom retires the paper-cat mascot and hands Stasi the plain marker and the method, designing a generous rematch so someone else runs and wins; his showman arc opens onto mentorship the class can call on next.

replay.withdrawnContentFallback: Use the same vivid-without-restoring editing evidence with neutral nameplates: a visual lead marks a withheld passage's place with a plain placeholder, a framing voice keeps it out of frame, and a sound-first voice checks the rewrite restores nothing.
